title: パワーエレクトロニクス
subtitle: Power Electronics
educationalGoal:
(1) Meaning of Power Electronics and its applications
(2) Basic principle, merits and demerits of power conversion using power devices
(3) Types and characteristics of major power semiconductor devices
(4) Fundamental circuits and operation of AC/DC, DC/DC and DC/AC circuits
advice:
Course Description
1.Introduction of power electronics
  1.1 Meaning of power electronics            1.2 Principle of high efficiency power conversion
  1.3 Types of power conversion
2.Features of power semiconductor devices
2.1 Classification and fundamental structure   2.2 Diode and thyristor
  2.3 Power transistor, MOSFET, IGBT
3.Power conversion circuits
  3.1 Rectifier circuit (AC/DC circuit)         3.2 Chopper and DC/DC converter
3.3 Inverter circuit (DC/AC circuit)
4.Applications of power electronics

Expectations for Students
To understand the lecture well, knowledge about electrical circuit, physical electronics, electromagnetics and transient phenomena in liner circuits are required.
requiredKnowledge: This course is strongly related with the following courses: ‘Electric Circuits’, ‘Electromagnetics’, ‘Transient Phenomena in Linear Circuits’, ‘Physical Electronics’, ‘Electrical Machinery’, ‘Generation of Electrical Energy’ and ‘High-voltage Pulsed Power Engineering’. It’s necessary to review the basic knowledges obtained from those related courses in advance.

activityGoals.body: To understand the meaning of power electronics and the features of power conversion using power devices
To understand the types and characteristics of major power semiconductor devices
To understand the fundamental circuit and operation of rectifier, chopper and inverter
To understand the output voltages and currents of rectifier, chopper and inverter
To understand PWM (Pulse Width Modulation) method used for power conversion circuits
To understand the necessity and applications of power electronics
